qr: QR code for the authenticator app
recoveryIntro: Recovery codes. Keep them somewhere other than your phone (print them, or put them in a password manager). Each works once and lets you in when you don't have the authenticator app at hand. You won't see them again.
passkeyNamePrompt: What should the passkey be called?
passkeyAdded: The passkey is added. Next time you can sign in with it.
noMethod: You have no way to sign in again yet. Add a passkey, set a password, or link a Google, Facebook, Microsoft or Seznam account.
passkeysIntro: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN. The safest and fastest way.
socialOff: Signing in with Google, Facebook, Microsoft or Seznam accounts isn't configured here.
passwordHint: At least {{count}} characters. A sentence of a few words is easy to remember.
totpIntro: After signing in with a password or a Google/Facebook/Microsoft/Seznam account, we also ask for a code from an app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…). Signing in with a passkey doesn't need the code.
